title: Personal Issues (Hard Version)
statementMd:
**This is the hard version of the problem. The difference between the versions is that in this version, $t \le 10^4$, $n \le 2 \cdot 10^5$ and the sum of $n$ over all test cases does not exceed $2 \cdot 10^5$. You can hack only if you solved all versions of this problem.**

The rivals Axial and Nife have had yet another argument, and they decided to settle it by playing a game on a tree.

They are given a tree with $n$ vertices numbered from $1$ to $n$. Each vertex contains either $0$ or $1$. Initially, two distinct vertices $x$ and $y$ contain $0$, and all other vertices contain $1$.

The players take turns, with Axial going first. On each turn, the current player chooses a vertex $v$ containing $1$ and changes its value to $0$. Before changing the value of $v$, let $c_v$ be the number of neighbors of $v$ that contain $0$. If $c_v = 1$, the current player gets one point. Otherwise, they get no points. The game ends when all vertices contain $0$.

Let $p$ and $q$ be the final scores of Axial and Nife, respectively. Axial wants to maximize $p - q$, while Nife wants to minimize it. Assuming both players play optimally, determine the value of $p - q$ at the end of the game.

## Input

Each test contains multiple test cases. The first line contains the number of test cases $t$ ($1 \le t \le 10^4$). The description of the test cases follows.

The first line of each test case contains three integers $n$, $x$, and $y$ ($2 \le n \le 2 \cdot 10^5$, $1 \le x, y \le n$, $x \ne y$) — the number of vertices in the tree and the two vertices that initially contain $0$.

Each of the next $n - 1$ lines contains two integers $u$ and $v$ ($1 \le u, v \le n$, $u \ne v$), denoting an edge between vertices $u$ and $v$.

It is guaranteed that the given graph is a tree.

It is guaranteed that the sum of $n$ over all test cases does not exceed $2 \cdot 10^5$.

## Output

For each test case, output a single integer — the value of $p - q$ at the end of the game.

## Note

In the figures below, blue vertices initially contain $0$, while white vertices initially contain $1$.

For the first example, the initial state is:

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/e9cd98c760fe6648d25e0a629a0cd74beffac9d8.png)

Axial changes vertex $3$ to $0$. It has exactly one neighbor containing $0$, so Axial gets one point. Therefore, $p - q=1$.

For the second example, the initial state is:

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/8509b22a1a90150db9d0ced2994f4b274ae098eb.png)

Axial can change either vertex $2$ or vertex $3$ to $0$ and get one point. After that, the remaining vertex has two neighbors containing $0$, so Nife gets no points. Therefore, $p - q=1$.

For the third example, the initial state is:

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/7ef05afa3fec9ce0ae24a054df3667379ed20537.png)

The only possible move is to change vertex $2$ to $0$. It has two neighbors containing $0$, so Axial gets no points. Therefore, $p - q=0$.
statementZhMd:
**这是本题的困难版本。与其他版本的区别在于，本版本中 $t \le 10^4$、$n \le 2 \cdot 10^5$，且所有测试用例的 $n$ 之和不超过 $2 \cdot 10^5$。只有解决了本题的所有版本，才能进行 hack。**

对手 Axial 和 Nife 又发生了争吵，于是他们决定在一棵树上进行游戏来解决争端。

给定一棵有 $n$ 个顶点的树，顶点编号为 $1$ 到 $n$。每个顶点上的值为 $0$ 或 $1$。初始时，两个不同的顶点 $x$ 和 $y$ 上的值为 $0$，其他所有顶点上的值均为 $1$。

两名玩家轮流行动，由 Axial 先手。每回合，当前玩家选择一个值为 $1$ 的顶点 $v$，并将其值改为 $0$。在修改 $v$ 的值之前，令 $c_v$ 表示 $v$ 的邻居中值为 $0$ 的顶点数量。如果 $c_v = 1$，当前玩家得一分；否则不得分。所有顶点的值都变为 $0$ 时，游戏结束。

设 Axial 和 Nife 最终的得分分别为 $p$ 和 $q$。Axial 希望最大化 $p - q$，而 Nife 希望最小化它。假设双方都采取最优策略，求游戏结束时 $p - q$ 的值。

## 输入格式

每个输入包含多组测试用例。第一行包含测试用例数量 $t$（$1 \le t \le 10^4$）。接下来是各测试用例的描述。

每个测试用例的第一行包含三个整数 $n$、$x$ 和 $y$（$2 \le n \le 2 \cdot 10^5$，$1 \le x, y \le n$，$x \ne y$）——树的顶点数，以及初始值为 $0$ 的两个顶点。

接下来的 $n - 1$ 行，每行包含两个整数 $u$ 和 $v$（$1 \le u, v \le n$，$u \ne v$），表示顶点 $u$ 和 $v$ 之间有一条边。

保证给定的图是一棵树。

保证所有测试用例的 $n$ 之和不超过 $2 \cdot 10^5$。

## 输出格式

对于每个测试用例，输出一个整数——游戏结束时 $p - q$ 的值。

## 说明

在下方的图中，蓝色顶点初始值为 $0$，白色顶点初始值为 $1$。

对于第一个样例，初始状态如下：

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/e9cd98c760fe6648d25e0a629a0cd74beffac9d8.png)

Axial 将顶点 $3$ 的值改为 $0$。它恰好有一个邻居的值为 $0$，因此 Axial 得一分。所以，$p - q=1$。

对于第二个样例，初始状态如下：

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/8509b22a1a90150db9d0ced2994f4b274ae098eb.png)

Axial 可以将顶点 $2$ 或顶点 $3$ 的值改为 $0$，并得一分。之后，剩下的那个顶点有两个邻居的值为 $0$，因此 Nife 不得分。所以，$p - q=1$。

对于第三个样例，初始状态如下：

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/7ef05afa3fec9ce0ae24a054df3667379ed20537.png)

唯一可能的操作是将顶点 $2$ 的值改为 $0$。它有两个邻居的值为 $0$，因此 Axial 不得分。所以，$p - q=0$。
